name: The Zombies Of Fear
summary:
Step into a full-throttle VR nightmare built for Meta Quest. Hurl an axe with deadly precision, sprint through shadowy alleys, and scour the map for diamond-filled chests—every chest holds one. Collect five diamonds to free the princess—if the horde doesn’t corner you first. A relentless blend of action, adventure, horror, and suspense, packed with tense chases and sharp jump scares.

Features

Satisfying axe-throw combat with weighty impact.

Relentless zombie hordes and nerve-wracking ambushes.
